enonce.texte:
Match the body part with its name. Write the correct letter next to each number.

  • 1. Head
  • 2. Arm
  • 3. Leg
  • 4. Foot
  • 5. Hand

Options: A. The part at the end of your arm. B. The part at the end of your leg. C. The top part of your body. D. The long part of your body between the shoulder and the hand. E. The long part of your body between the hip and the foot.
images: Simple silhouette of a human body with numbered parts: head, arm, leg, foot, hand.

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences with 'have got' or 'has got'.

questions.texte: Choose the correct form of 'have got'.
questions.reponse: 1. has got, 2. have got, 3. have got, 4. has got

enonce.texte: You are at a doctor's office in Cameroon. Describe your symptoms to the doctor. Use at least three symptoms and the verb 'have got'.

questions.texte: Write a short dialogue or description.
questions.reponse: Example: Doctor: Good morning. What's the problem? Patient: Good morning, doctor. I have got a headache. I have got a fever too. I also have got a cough.

enonce.texte: Match the symptom with the correct medical advice.

sousQuestions.reponse: Take a fever reducer and rest.

enonce.texte: You are in a pharmacy in Cameroon. Ask for medicine for a headache and a fever. Write the dialogue between you and the pharmacist.

questions.reponse: Example: Me: Good morning. I have got a headache and a fever. Can you give me something for them? Pharmacist: Yes, take this medicine. Take one pill every 8 hours. Me: Thank you very much.

enonce.texte: Rewrite the sentences using 'have got' in the correct form.

questions.reponse: 1. Have you got a headache? 2. She has not got a fever. 3. They have got a cough.

sousQuestions.reponse: She has not got a fever.

enonce.texte: You are at a hospital in Cameroon. You have a stomachache and a fever. Create a dialogue between you, the nurse, and the doctor. Include symptoms, questions, and advice.

questions.reponse: Example: Nurse: Good morning. Please have a seat. Doctor: Hello. What is your name? Patient: My name is... Doctor: What is the problem? Patient: I have got a stomachache and a fever. Doctor: Let me examine you... You should rest and drink a lot of water. I will give you some medicine. Patient: Thank you, doctor.

intitule: Resource: Body Parts and Health Vocabulary

enonce.texte: Your friend has a headache and a fever. Write an email giving them advice on what to do and what medicine to take.

questions.reponse: Example: Dear [Friend's Name], I am sorry to hear about your headache and fever. You should take a painkiller for the headache and a fever reducer. Rest in bed and drink a lot of water. If you don't feel better, see a doctor. Take care.
